name: XOrder
caption: Əlavə modullar / Mühasibat və balans / Sərəncam

datasets.name: CurrencyData
datasets.sql:
select
  Valute ,
  Val_Name ,
  Valu_Name ,
  Valu_Bala
from 
  AVALUTE

datasets.name: ContractAccs
datasets.sql:
select
  Val_Acc ,
  Acc_No ,
  KLI_ID ,
  Name
from
  Account
where
  Val_acc = :Val_Acc
order by
  Acc_No

datasets.name: ClientAccs
datasets.sql:
select
  Val_Acc ,
  KLI_ID ,
  Acc_No ,
  Name
from
  Account
where
  Val_acc = :Val_Acc

order by
  Acc_No

datasets.name: ReserveAccs
datasets.sql:
select
  Val_Acc ,
KLI_ID ,
  Acc_No ,
  Name
from
  Account  ac ,
  archost ar
where
  Val_acc = :Val_Acc and
       ar.datdate =(select TEK_DAT from sysdat)
    and ar.acc_id = ac.id
    and ar.pok_ostat>0
    and
  (BAL_CN1 in
    (select ACCGROUP from SBCM_ACC_ZONE_INFO
    where zoneid = (select zoneid from sbcm_acc_zones where name = 'Reserv')))

order by
  Acc_No
